archimate:CourseOfAction.name: 4. standardising our delivery partnerships​
archimate:CourseOfAction.documentation:
Providing colleagues a consistent way to set up and manage partnerships, so less time is lost to inconsistent processes.​
Focus are pre-Christmas but opportunity to refine across January / March. Focus is on the approach and the level of priority each partnership has; technology requirement mainly relating to access, with requirements linked to end-to-end pipeline once a partner begins to progress an opportunity. ​
Level 2 capabilities are: Market-making ​ Partnership engagement and shaping ​ Operations oversight​ Service and product development ​ Portfolio, programme and project management ​ Strategic prioritisation and triage​
